consistency_internal.explantion: Both Response a and Response b exhibit the same high‑severity flaws identified in the critique reports: each contains Blurred Viewpoints/Conflation (mixing distinct perspectives without clear separation) and presents contested statements as undisputed facts, a False Consensus error.
